verdict.rationale: The evidence shows individual skill docs (review, cso) that analyze *user* code for security issues, but there is no dedicated documentation of gstack's own security posture, no stated trust model for installing/running third-party skills, and no telemetry/data-collection disclosure. In fact, a community comment explicitly notes telemetry exists but was never disclosed or explained ('Noone seems to have mentioned that Gstack has Telemetry... backdoor way for YC to get signal'), underscoring the absence of documented posture rather than confirming it.
